name: schoolane
description: Role-aware school context, curriculum drafting, and governed timetable drafts through the authenticated SchooLane MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Review curriculum and prepare timetable drafts
interface.longDescription: SchooLane gives Codex a governed school-operations connection. Inspect only the school data allowed by the signed-in user's current role, draft curriculum, and prepare unpublished timetable projects without bypassing human review or publication.
defaultPrompt: Show me the classes and curriculum I can access
Review my term scheme and identify planning gaps
Draft next week's lesson plan for one of my classes
Prepare an unpublished timetable draft for next term
